query: UPDATE git_work_surface_details g SET connection_id = c.id, credential_kind = NULL, credential_encrypted = NULL, github_app_installation_id = NULL, github_app_write_enabled = false FROM provider_connections c WHERE g.id = $1 AND c.id = $2 AND c.owner_user_id = $3 AND c.revoked_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_surface_managers m WHERE m.surface_id = g.id AND m.user_id = $3)
